text: Phase 2. Real-time protection and dashboard. The second layer works in real-time. It
detects attacks like front running or sandwich attacks and activates the safe mode to private
relays. So, boards can't take advantage. A dashboard acts like the F1 pit wall and showing
actions of every transactions. Hair car represents transactions and flag represents signals.
Green flag means safe and red flag means under attack. Users can even view simulations to see
how much laws they've avoided two days fine.
